items.title: Leonard Bocage Interview, 1972-03-24
items.q: We never did get all the different people in Red Allen's band. ... Bebe, that's the one that played, uh, played trap drums.

ctx.x: Well, who was Bebe Matthews? Which one was Bebe?
Bebe, that's the one that played, uh, played trap drums.
Oh, that's, that's the same as Turk.
